| **Baan Thai** | 1230 W 19th St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑0234 | *Green Curry*（素食版）、*Massaman Curry*（素食版）、*Coconut Rice*、*Vegetable Satay* |
| **Thai House** | 456 S Michigan Ave, Chicago, IL 60605 | (312) 555‑0456 | *Red Curry*（素食版）、*Mango Sticky Rice*、*Vegetable Stir‑Fry*、*Spring Rolls* |
